skill_name: Write a paragraph describing a typical day as a web developer.
workflow: Web developers have a wide range of responsibilities. On any given day, they might work with clients to understand their needs, design new websites and applications, or modify existing ones. They might also fix technical problems, troubleshoot software issues, develop code, test websites, and perform various other tasks.
